note: RV park and cabins on Norris Freeway in Rocky Top, beside Coal Creek and the railway, with a playground, an RC course and a food truck. It sits 2.8 miles from the Windrock off-road trailhead, and the Devil's Triangle motorcycle loop and Norris Lake are nearby. --Claude
summary: Coal Creek Campground: 18 full-hookup 80-ft pull-throughs (50 A on 2-12, 30 A on 16-25), $40 every night checked Dec 2026-Jul 2027 (price gate passes), year-round, own booking site; Google 4.5/51. OHV-base FLAG for the reviewer (markets Windrock/Royal Blue trails, 'stage area', OHV rules; trailhead 2.8 mi away; also markets motorcycling and Norris Lake).
flags: OHV (reviewer, not dropped): the home page leads with 'Access to Windrock Park and Royal Blue Off-road Riding Trails' ('You can easily access the beautiful Windrock Park and Royal Blue trails from our spot'); the rules provide for early arrivals to 'access the trails', mention 'extra parking in the stage area', and govern 'age-appropriate off-highway vehicles' for children; a testimonial praises how it caters 'to those enjoying the offroad activities (ATV, SXS, and Jeeps)'. Against: the trails are not on site ('TRAILS: 2.8 miles from campground to trail head. YOU MUST HAVE A WINDROCK RIDING PERMIT.'), and it markets equally the Devil's Triangle motorcycle roads, Norris Lake and Cumberland Mountain drives. My read: a general RV park with a strong OHV side, but it fits 'private parks marketing ATV trails from the campground' closely enough for the reviewer to decide.

PRICE GATE passes: $40 a night (posted and quoted by the booking engine on four dates incl. Saturdays and 3 July 2027). Google 4.5 over 51; RV Life 4*/$$ as stored. Long-stay tests: nightly bookable sites only, no seasonal/monthly offer posted; one testimonial mentions an extended stay - passes.
SITES: the uniform '80′ Pull Through' on every listing may be a template value; the pads on imagery are long gravel pull-throughs consistent with it.
FACILITIES: 'Bathhouse with 4 Private Bathrooms' - showers not stated, left unknown. No dump station needed (full hookups).
PIN 36.2286,-84.1612 is on the campground's pads (Google's listing point 36.22727,-84.16016 is ~170 m SE, at the office end). Not waterfront kept: Coal Creek runs behind a tree line on the east side.
